name: Desert Ranger
bio: Two tours in the sand. Thinks the arena is a nice change of scenery.
notes: Downloaded by hand (owner, 2026-10-29) as an unrigged textured GLB; rigged by Meshy's rigging API (source.modelUrl "upload", the download sent as a data URI). Queue note: US soldier, desert.
